name: minimax-subagents
description: MiniMax subagents and tiered workers on the Token Plan subscription, run inline through OpenCode from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity (Agy) and Gemini CLI. Ships mm-run (tier/effort routing to lean workers, thinking stripped, transient retry, quota fallback exit 75, parallel cap), mm_fast/mm_m3/mm_flash worker lanes via smart-sub-agents, Claude/Agy bridge agents, and a one-shot cross-harness installer. Use when delegating coding, refactor, docs, long-context or multimodal work to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview, MiniMax-M3 or MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed.
